_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global specialty biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' (Item 1A heading); 'We could lose market exclusivity of a product earlier than expected.' (Item 1A heading); 'We depend on several key products for most of our revenues, cash flows and earnings.' (Item 1A heading)

BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY07-FY16 ex-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +8.8%/yr (Q2 sales ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 median

BULL.desc: EPS +16.9%/yr (FY07-FY16 ex-FY15 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +58.4%/yr (best 2-yr run FY07-FY16 ex-FY15); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2017-10-13) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.39x (84.7% downside to Bear $10 / +60.8% upside to Bull $105) | Adj composite 2.23 vs market 2.29: gap -0.06 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +42% above the EPP floor $46 (17x FY17E $2.71) | Conservative 2-yr case: -0.3% total (-0.2%/yr) | At 24.1x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $86 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; U.S. revenues +6.6% in Q2 2017, forward revenues +7% (no FY17 revenue guide in numbers, Q2 2017 net sales growth ex-FX); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
